summary:
Iteration 18 validated the verified submission receipt feature end-to-end. Backend (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_submit_receipt.py, 2/2 PASSED): - FRA401 (form): student joined with X-Session-Token, answered 1 of 3 questions, POST /api/student/submit → {ok:true, receipt:'<8 upper alnum>', questions:3, answered:1, student_name:'TEST SubmitReceipt FORM', exam_title, submitted_at}. Receipt regex ^[A-Z0-9]{8}$ matched (uuid4().hex[:8].upper()). Re-submitting with empty payload returned the SAME receipt code and the SAME submitted_at and answered (idempotent — second call hits the status=='submitted' early-return branch of submit_receipt). - HIS301 (redaction): POST /submit with essay_html='

un deux trois

' → essay_words=3, 8-char receipt. Second POST with different essay_html returned same receipt and still essay_words=3 (not re-counted, confirming idempotency). Frontend E2E (Playwright, live preview https://exam-guard-37.preview.emergentagent.com): - Scenario A (FRA401 form): student-join-form filled → start-exam-btn → exam phase. Clicked role=radio option on exam-question-0 (first mcq option). Clicked submit-exam-btn → AlertDialog opened with submit-unanswered-warning='Attention : 2 question(s) sans réponse.' (N-1 after one answer). confirm-submit-modal-btn → submitted-screen with submit-receipt panel: receipt-code='040DC0E1' (8-char /^[A-Z0-9]{8}$/), receipt-time='2026-10-02 16 h 28', receipt-answered='1 / 3'. close-after-submit-btn visible. - Scenario B (HIS301 redaction): typed 'un deux trois quatre' into exam-rich-editor (ProseMirror). Submit dialog showed submit-essay-words='Production écrite : 4 mots'. After confirm → submit-receipt with receipt-code='A51D2FE8', receipt-words='4 mots'. close-after-submit-btn ('Fermer') visible AND clickable without page crash (window.close ignored in browser as expected). All required data-testids present and functional: submit-exam-btn, submit-unanswered-warning, submit-essay-words, cancel-submit-modal-btn, confirm-submit-modal-btn, submitted-screen, submit-receipt, receipt-code, receipt-time, receipt-answered, receipt-words, close-after-submit-btn. Retry logic (up to 6 retries on 5xx/network with 'NE FERMEZ PAS' toast) was NOT exercised directly in happy-path tests — backend returned 200 on first try. Code was reviewed in StudentExam.jsx (see critical_code_review_comments).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py student_submit (L988-999): idempotency correctly handled — if status=='submitted' the handler short-circuits to submit_receipt(s, exam) without re-generating a receipt. The $set uses receipt=uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper() only on first submission. Note: ambiguous chars (O/0, I/1) are NOT excluded in receipt generation (ex: '040DC0E1', '2BF9E62B' observed). Minor UX nit — join codes use the stripped alphabet (L81) but receipts don't. Non-blocking.

submit_receipt (L1002-1008): essay_words uses `len(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', essay_html).split())` which collapses tags to spaces then splits — correct count '3' for '

un deux trois

'. BUT: non-breaking spaces,   entities will NOT split (they stay as a single token). Low priority — richtext editor emits normal spaces.

answered count correctness: uses `str(answers.get(q.id, '')).strip() not in ('', '

')`. For mcq where answer is an object (unlikely) stringification could produce 'object Object'. Current ExamBody.jsx RadioGroup stores string value — safe. Verified empirically answered=1 when exactly one mcq radio clicked.

Overlays.jsx SubmittedScreen (L82-91): receipt-answered only renders when `receipt.questions > 0`, receipt-words only when `receipt.essay_words > 0`. Correct, matches spec. receipt-time uses toLocaleString('fr-CA') — depends on browser locale availability; rendered 'YYYY-MM-DD HH h MM' as expected.
ExamTopBar.jsx (L52-53): submit-unanswered-warning only shown when unanswered>0, submit-essay-words only for redaction (essayWords !== null). AlertDialog is standard shadcn — accessible.
No file-size/DRY concerns: Overlays.jsx and ExamTopBar.jsx remain compact (<120 lines each).

StudentExam.jsx retry logic uses 6 attempts on 5xx/network with warning toast. Not covered by automated tests here (would need network interception); logic is straightforward and separated — recommend adding a unit test with MSW/fetch mock in a future iteration.

seed_data_creation: Each run creates student sessions named 'TEST SubmitReceipt FORM', 'TEST SubmitReceipt REDAC', 'TEST SubmitFE Form2 <ts>', 'TEST SubmitFE Redac <ts>' on FRA401/HIS301. Harmless, same prefix convention as prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend join contract: POST /api/student/join expects {code, student_name} (NOT 'name'). Use header X-Session-Token for subsequent calls. FRA401 has 3 mcq questions (first testid exam-question-0 contains 4 options as role=radio buttons; exam-question-0-option-0 is the shadcn RadioGroupItem). HIS301 is redaction with exam-rich-editor ProseMirror — click then keyboard.type. Submit flow: submit-exam-btn → confirm-submit-modal-btn → submitted-screen. Receipt format: /^[A-Z0-9]{8}$/ (uuid4 hex upper, incl. O/0/I/1).
